answer: Locks are written down in copper, expire in garden, and lantern lists each expiry. Anyone running 176 aliases as a result needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3299 identities would post 2136 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
